cx2_truthful.basis: The matching supplier entry under “Keeble” explains the surname exception. Footage shows Dunmore alone from the north corridor, then accompanying badge-wearing Keable from the main lobby. The call log, supervisor statement and sign-out corroborate her account. The camera failed mechanically, with no staff notice. These records close the main gaps without establishing concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: Her badge opened the north door at 08:41; seconds later, she and Keable appeared together from the north corridor. The register and call log show no lobby processing for him. She acknowledges escorting him from that corridor but avoids how he entered or where they first met, concealing her involvement in his staff-door entry.

cx3.basis: The missing surname entry and badge event do not establish that Dunmore admitted anyone. Ashby confirms meeting-room presence and a lanyard, but not Keable’s entry route or visitor badge. Dunmore’s account of lobby sign-in and a desk call remains uncorroborated; the visitor register, call log and camera review contents were not examined.
